en:
## New Features

- Volume snapshots for container data: create, apply, and delete snapshots with concurrency protection and path validation
- Desktop message block multi-select: Ctrl/Cmd+Click to toggle, Shift+Click for range selection, Escape to exit
- Dockerfile and .dockerignore for containerized deployment

## Bug Fixes

- Extracted TruncatedPath shared component, eliminating duplicated path truncation UI across file modification tabs
- File paths now display as project-relative paths instead of absolute paths
- Fixed userId retrieval pattern in volume snapshot routes
- SetupWizard model validation: verify provider availability, guard against settings race condition
- PathInput: removed onFocus auto-dropdown (redundant with onChange/useEffect)
- Settings route: added webFetchPolicy Zod validation schema
- Snapshot create/apply protected by AsyncMutex to prevent concurrent corruption
- Apply snapshot now ensures target directory exists (mkdir -p)
- Container path validation: must be absolute and cannot contain ..
- isPending loading state scoped to specific snapshotId

## Refactoring

- Consolidated 4 different Bun --hot reload patterns into shared `server/lib/hot-safe.ts` module with semantic APIs (hotSafe, hotTimer, hotTimerClear, hotOnce)
- Fixed process.on("exit") handler accumulation in db/index.ts via hotOnce
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 容器数据卷快照：支持创建、应用、删除快照，含并发保护和路径校验
- 桌面端消息块多选：Ctrl/Cmd+Click 切换选中，Shift+Click 范围选中，Escape 退出多选
- 新增 Dockerfile 和 .dockerignore，支持容器化部署

## 修复

- 提取 TruncatedPath 公共组件，消除文件修改面板中重复的路径截断 UI
- 文件路径显示改为项目相对路径
- 修复 volume snapshot 路由中 userId 获取方式
- SetupWizard 模型验证：校验 provider 可用性，防止 settings 竞态
- PathInput：移除 onFocus 自动弹出下拉（onChange/useEffect 已覆盖）
- settings 路由：补齐 webFetchPolicy 的 Zod 验证 schema
- 快照 create/apply 加 AsyncMutex 并发锁保护
- apply 快照前 mkdir -p 确保目标路径存在
- containerPath 校验：必须绝对路径且不含 ..
- isPending loading 状态精确匹配到具体 snapshotId

## 重构

- 将 4 种 Bun --hot 热重载模式统一为 `server/lib/hot-safe.ts` 共享模块，提供 hotSafe、hotTimer、hotTimerClear、hotOnce 四个语义化 API
- 通过 hotOnce 修复 db/index.ts 中 process.on("exit") 处理器累积问题
